incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated error rate detected for model variant `alpha-lite-v2` (EU region). 5xx pct increased from 0.3% -> 8.5% in last 2m. Auto-escalation triggered.
Luca: Oncall here, acknowledging. grabbing logs now. which traffic route is this hitting?
Alice: Looks like prod-router -> alpha-lite-v2 (canary) got ~12% of generation traffic for chat.v2. Errors start at step=decode.
Kate: Customer-facing impact: approx 2% of active keys saw increased latency and some 5xx. Not yet a broad outage but we should act fast.
Luca: Agreed. Plan: 1) temporarily remove `alpha-lite-v2` from routing 2) shift traffic to `stable-v1.3` 3) enforce emergency per-key quotas for heavy keys until we have root cause. Anyone object?
Greg: No objections. I'll execute the traffic remove and post outputs.
Greg: /cmd
```
redwood control variants disable --model alpha-lite-v2 --reason "Emergency: elevated 5xx" --dry-run=false
```
Greg: running now...
deploy-bot: deploy started: variant-disable-2267801245 by Greg
Greg: Disable command returned: SUCCESS. Node groups draining, routing rules updated. Estimated switch completion ~15s.
deploy-bot: routing sync complete. 12% -> 0% traffic to `alpha-lite-v2`. Fallthrough to `stable-v1.3`.
Luca: Observing metrics... error rate for overall chat.v2 dropping. 5xx now 1.1% across region. Latency back to baseline. :thumbsup:
Sahni: I'm opening a customer-impact ticket to track any users who saw failures. Ticket: RED-7891. Noting two enterprise customers on affected keys (cust-A, cust-B).
Alice: Creating temporary emergency quotas: cap top 50 keys at 200 rps -> 50 rps and enforce token-bucket refill 1s.
Alice: /cmd
```
redwood control quotas update --scope keys --selector "top50" --limit 50 --duration 60m --reason "mitigation: reduce amplification"
```
Alice: done, policy applied.
Kate: Can we snapshot the variant state + logs before we garbage it? we might want to repro.
Greg: Snapshot saved: s3://redwood-incident-snapshots/2267801234-alpha-lite-v2.tgz
Luca: Handing pager to Alice for follow-up. I'm going offline for 30m to grab dinner but will check in. @Alice you're now primary oncall for incident RED-7891.
Alice: Taking handoff. I've read the runbook. Next steps: keep `alpha-lite-v2` disabled, run a canary against `alpha-lite-v2` on staging with smaller seq len, and gather kernel-level traces from nodes that reported OOMs.
Sahni: Heads-up: cust-B reported 3 failed customer requests earlier; support notified cust-B with ETA 45m.
Alice: Given the risk surface and since drain completed quickly, decision: do not re-enable `alpha-lite-v2` for now. We'll roll back traffic permanently to `stable-v1.3` for the next 24h while root cause is investigated. Creating rollback job.
Greg: /cmd
```
redwood control rollout set-default --model chat.v2 --variant stable-v1.3 --reason "Emergency rollback after alpha-lite-v2 elevated 5xx"
```
Greg: rollout job queued. deploy-bot: rollout job started: rollout-2267801310
deploy-bot: rollout complete. Default variant is now `stable-v1.3`.
Luca: Thanks team. Postmortem owner assigned: Greg. Oncall handoff completed to Alice. Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring.
Sahni: I'll keep customer comms updated and attach logs to RED-7891.
Alice: I'll coordinate with eng-runtime to reproduce and root-cause. Notifying eng-runtime on-call. @eng-runtime oncall please ack.
incident-bot: NOTE: Follow-up actions recorded: (1) Postmortem due in 72h (owner: Greg) (2) Kernel traces and model logs uploaded (3) Emergency quotas expire in 60m unless extended.
Kate: Thx. Closing slack thread for paging; keep this channel updated with major changes. :white_check_mark:
_meta: Generated Slack thread JSON for incident mitigation: temporary disable of a model variant and rollback to stable variant.
